packages.appDescription: The IPTV Player PRO - High-performance, production-ready IPTV player for LG webOS TVs (webOS 4.0 through webOS 26). Features 10-foot remote navigation, native 4K HDR10/Dolby Vision pipeline, EPG, Xtream Codes, Live DVR, and LAN companion.
